5.2 Map
The MAP function establishes the context to frame risks related to an AI system.
Page 24
NIST AI 100-1 AI RMF 1.0
Outcomes in the MAP function are the basis for the MEASURE and MANAGE functions.
Practices related to mapping AI risks are described in the NIST AI RMF Playbook. Table
2 lists the MAP function's categories and subcategories.

6. AI RMF Profiles
